outcome: Risk of second primary rectal cancer (SPRC)
cohort: This study used data from the SEER database and included 573,306 patients diagnosed with primary pelvic cancer between 1973 and 2016.
finding: Patients who received pelvic radiation therapy for primary pelvic cancer had an increased risk of developing second primary rectal cancer, particularly with the combination of external beam radiation therapy and brachytherapy.
